subject: Onsite visit: demo timing change — decision-maker travel conflict
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@greenwayhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onsite demo during Feb 23 field visit — confirm timing

Hi Vanessa & Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick call last week. Our team will be on-site at the Austin lab the week of Feb 23 for a series of supplier reviews. We'd like to schedule a 60–75 minute demo and walkthrough while we're there — ideally the morning of Tue, Feb 24, between 9:00–11:30am. Attendees will include Tom Alvarez (IT lead) and me; we may add one clinical operations manager.

Attached is a rough agenda and the SOW draft for context. Can you confirm whether that morning window works and who from your side will join onsite versus remote?

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Reed
Director, Clinical Partnerships
Greenway Health
attachments: Greenway_Onsite_Agenda_v1.pdf, SOW_draft_2026-02-05.docx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@greenwayhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 13:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo during Feb 23 field visit — confirm timing

Hi Samantha — thanks for the agenda. Tue, Feb 24 morning should be fine. Proposed plan from our side:

- Vanessa Ortiz (onsite) — executive overview + customer success context
- Marissa Cole (remote) — product demo and integration Q&A
- Dev Patel (remote) — technical deep-dive and deployment patterns

Two quick questions:
1) If the clinical operations manager joins, will they want a specific clinical workflow walkthrough? We can bring a short focused segment (20 minutes).
2) Are there any required network/VPN access steps for the demo machines on your internal network?

If that window is confirmed, I can send a calendar invite and a short logistics note (parking, room, Wi‑Fi).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenwayhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:58:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo during Feb 23 field visit — confirm timing

Hi all — quick update from our side: travel changed on our end. The executive sponsor who was planned to join has been pulled into an offsite in Boston and will only be available remotely the afternoon of Feb 24. Given that their input is critical for procurement timeline, we were wondering whether you have flexibility to either:

A) Move the demo to Wed, Feb 25 (same morning window) so the exec can join in person; or
B) Keep Tue, Feb 24 but shift to 2:00–3:30pm CT so the exec can dial in from Boston (we'd need a brief Q&A at the end for procurement questions).

Apologies for the late notice. We're still committed to proceeding during the visit but want to make sure the right stakeholders see the demo live.

—Tom
Tom Alvarez
IT Director, Greenway Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenwayhealth.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo during Feb 23 field visit — confirm timing

Thanks for the heads-up, Tom — totally understand. Short reply with options so we can lock calendars: 

Option 1 — Move in-person to Wed, Feb 25 9:00–10:15am CT: we can have Vanessa onsite, Marissa remote (she will still run the product demo), and Dev remote for the technical Q&A. This gives your exec the chance to join in person.

Option 2 — Keep Tue, Feb 24 but move to 2:00–3:30pm CT, with a 15-minute executive Q&A at 3:15. We will bring a brief procurement slide set for that slot.

If neither works, we can also run the demo Tue morning as planned and schedule a short follow-up session (30 minutes) the following week specifically for procurement decisions.

Please confirm which you prefer and I'll send the updated calendar invite + logistics (room, parking, dial-in).

Action items: 
- Samantha: confirm attendee list and whether clinical workflow segment is needed.
- Tom: pick Option 1 or 2 (or suggest alternate).
- Marissa/Dev: hold both CT windows for now; Vanessa will commit to whichever is chosen.

Thanks — Van
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: procurement_slide_deck_draft.pdf (will share after confirm)
